findings.title: Oversized bed_id / watering id makes the watering endpoints return 500
findings.actual: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error (plain text) on all three
findings.evidence: curl returned 'Internal Server Error 500' for each; bed_id is `int` with gt=0 but no upper bound, so sqlite raises OverflowError

findings.title: Retrying 'Water now' or 'Save watering' after a timeout or lost response records a duplicate watering
findings.steps: Click 'Water now'; the response is lost or slow (the request has no timeout), the user clicks again after the failure
findings.expected: One watering per intended action (idempotency key or dedupe)
findings.actual: Each POST inserts a new row and there is no idempotency key or dedupe. Several 'now' POSTs sent within the same second each created a separate row (ids 3, 4, 6).
findings.evidence: Separate POST /api/waterings calls within one second each returned 201 with a new id; the code has no request id or uniqueness check

findings.title: Watering requests have no timeout, so buttons can stay in 'Watering…'/'Saving…' forever
findings.where: Beds page Water now / Save watering, Waterings page delete, dashboard and waterings list fetches
findings.steps: Make the API hang (accept the connection but never answer), then click 'Water now'
findings.expected: Fail after 10 s with a visible error and the button enabled again
findings.actual: useApiClient/useApiFetch set no timeout, so the button stays disabled with 'Watering…' indefinitely
findings.evidence: composables/useApi.ts $fetch.create has no timeout option; recordWatering awaits the fetch with no limit

findings.title: Dashboard 'Recent waterings' error has no retry
findings.expected: Error message with a Retry button that refetches
findings.actual: Only an alert is shown. `refresh` for the waterings fetch is never taken out of the fetch result, so the only way to recover is a full reload
findings.evidence: index.vue: `const { data: waterings, error: wateringsError } = wateringsResult`, and the template has no retry control

findings.title: Waterings page error state has no retry and the bed list fails silently
findings.steps: Open /waterings while the API errors (or /api/beds fails)
findings.expected: Error with a Retry button; the bed filter says it could not load beds
findings.actual: The waterings error alert has no retry. If /api/beds fails, the error is ignored: the filter only shows 'All beds' and gives no message
findings.evidence: waterings.vue only uses `data` from bedsResult; no retry button in the template

findings.title: Invalid ?bed= in the URL shows a raw validation message and an unselected filter
findings.expected: Ignore the bad filter or show a friendly message, with the select showing the active filter
findings.actual: bed=abc shows the alert 'Query.bed id: Input should be a valid integer, unable to parse string as an integer'. bed=999 shows 'No waterings for this bed' while the select shows no matching option
findings.evidence: SSR HTML of /waterings?bed=abc contains that alert text; bed=999 renders '0 waterings' with no selected option

findings.title: 'Watered X' success is shown even when refreshing the bed list fails
findings.steps: Click 'Water now'; the POST succeeds but the following GET /api/beds fails
findings.expected: Success plus an error saying the list could not be refreshed, with no stale data presented as current
findings.actual: useFetch refresh() does not throw, so recordWatering returns true and shows the success notice while 'Last watered' stays stale

findings.title: Tiny litre amounts are accepted but display as '0 L'; extreme past dates accepted
findings.where: Beds page past watering form / POST /api/waterings, waterings list
findings.steps: Record a past watering with litres 0.0001 (or watered_on 0001-01-01)
findings.expected: Reject the value with a reason, or show it accurately
findings.actual: The server accepts 0.0001 L and formatLitres (max 2 fraction digits) shows '0 L'. The date 0001-01-01 is accepted as a watering date

findings.title: litres: true is accepted as 1 litre
Past-watering form does not fit 375 px
findings.where: Beds page, Record past watering form
findings.steps: Open /beds at 375 px width and click 'Record past watering'
findings.actual: .water-form uses grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr auto with no mobile override, so the date input, number input and two buttons sit in one row, likely wider than the card and causing sideways scrolling
findings.evidence: main.css: .water-form has no rule in @media (max-width: 720px), unlike .filters

findings.title: 'Water now' date and the client's max date can disagree across time zones
findings.where: POST /api/waterings and the past watering form
findings.steps: Use the app from a time zone ahead of the server and pick today's date in the form
findings.actual: The form's max and default use the browser's todayIso(), but the server rejects dates after its own date.today() ('Watering date cannot be in the future.'). 'Water now' stores watered_on in server local time and watered_at in UTC
findings.evidence: schemas.py not_in_future uses date.today(); waterings.py uses now.astimezone().date()
